notes.title: [V1.0.1] Initial bug-fixes!
notes.content:
NECROMANCIA IS HERE!!!
Necromancia Update!!! 
Today is release day and with our release comes...

BUGS!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022836/8c6be42a89bbdde401ad27b554d5554e307f8307.png
Juan Dingus enjoying his summer. Annoying minions omitted.


Changes:
-Fixed game-breaking level 2 bug
-Fixed brown minion detection/general collision
-Improved hit detection for minions
-Code improvements



Future:
For the future, we're constantly working on bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Content-wise, we're looking at expanding the story to include additional creative levels and soon, possibly even... [spoiler]Achievements ;)[/spoiler]!!

Have a great summer necromancers!
